welcome: A little care goes a long way.
tagline: Track repairs. Plan maintenance. Protect your home.
privacy_intro: Your records stay on this device. No account, location tracking or advertising. Choose your preferences, then make Fixavora your own.
a_little_care: A LITTLE CARE. LASTING PEACE OF MIND.
dashboard_intro: The small things that keep your home running, all in one place.
maintenance_at_your_pace: A clear view of what needs a little attention.
add_your_next_task: Add your next maintenance task to see it here.
everything_in_one_place: Useful details, right where you need them.
ask_your_assistant: Speak or type to your assistant
add_record_intro: Add a record and build a useful history of your home.
currencies_kept_separate: Totals are grouped by currency. No exchange rates are applied.
no_expenses: Your saved expenses will appear here.
title: Name or title
form_error: Check the required fields, dates, currency and amounts. Use the formats shown below each field.
money_format: Use a decimal point, without a currency symbol. For example 49.99.
attachments_after_save: Save a record first, then open it to attach photos, receipts or a manual.
document_privacy: Files remain in your chosen storage provider. Fixavora keeps a read-only link and does not upload files.
delete_property_warning: This deletes the property and all its rooms, tasks, repairs and linked records from Fixavora. External files are not deleted.
delete_warning: This record and its history will be deleted. External files are not deleted.
a_helping_hand: A helping hand for your home
local_assistant_intro: Turn your words into a task draft, or ask for a summary of your saved records. Runs locally; you review every change.
voice_privacy: Tap to speak. Your installed speech engine may process audio online under its own policy. Fixavora does not save recordings. Typing always works.
safety_guardrail: For gas, electrical, structural or fire-safety work, arrange assessment by a qualified professional. This app provides organisation guidance, not repair procedures or safety certification.
assistant_reads_local: Summaries use only what you have saved. Nothing is sent to a remote AI service.
contractor_questions_text: What work do you recommend? What is included in the quote? Which qualifications and insurance are relevant? What will it cost, and when can it be completed? What documents should I keep?
maintenance_template_text: General organisation checklist: identify the appliance or area; consult the manufacturer's guidance; choose a suitable qualified professional where needed; set a schedule for your situation; save the service date and receipt. No inspection or compliance is implied.
remote_ai_unavailable: Drafts are prepared on this device. Date and category suggestions may be incomplete; review all details before saving.
translation_review_notice: Choose your preferred language. Speech services and available voices depend on your device.
reminder_limitations: Reminders are checked periodically, not at an exact time. Fire OS battery settings, notification permissions and device availability can delay delivery. Quiet hours use device local time.
privacy_detail: No mandatory account, advertising or product analytics. Home records stay in private app storage. Amazon and our receipt verifier process purchase identifiers to check Premium access. Optional speech and document providers have their own privacy policies. You choose where exports go. No remote AI processing.
backup_attachment_notice: Encrypted backups include records and history. Documents and photos are external links and are not included; retain separate copies and relink them after restoring.
backup_password_notice: Use at least 12 characters. Keep the passphrase somewhere safe; it cannot be recovered.
restore_warning: Restoring replaces all current home records and history. Attachment links will be removed. Export a backup first if you need to keep the current data.
delete_all_warning: Delete all properties, records, history, attachment links and preferences on this device? Your Amazon purchase and files stored elsewhere are not deleted.
premium_intro: More room for the homes you care for.
premium_records: Expanded records, warranties and contractor directory
premium_reports: Expense summaries and PDF / CSV exports
free_tier_detail: Free: one active property, up to 15 active maintenance tasks, basic repairs and appliance records. Existing records remain readable if Premium becomes unavailable.
premium_ai_policy: Premium is a one-time Amazon purchase. The store displays the price for your marketplace. You confirm purchases with Amazon; no subscription is started.
reports_intro: Reports use the current property. Filter dates and record types before exporting.
export_privacy_warning: This export may contain private property information. Only save or share it with a destination you trust.
premium_required: This addition needs Premium. Your existing records remain available.
invalid_record: Check the record fields and linked property.
undo_unavailable: Undo is available immediately after the latest completion, before further changes.
operation_failed: That action could not be completed. Check your entries and storage, then try again.
no_compatible_app: No compatible app is available on this device.
document_unavailable: The file could not be opened. It may have moved, or a compatible viewer may be unavailable. Attach it again if needed.
voice_unavailable: Speech recognition is unavailable on this device. You can type your request instead.
microphone_denied: Microphone access was not granted. Type your request or enable microphone access in device settings.
voice_error: Speech could not be recognised. Try again or type your request.
tts_unavailable: Spoken feedback is unavailable for this device or language. Your response remains visible.
notifications_denied: Notifications were not enabled. Your tasks remain visible in the app.
billing_unavailable: Amazon purchasing is unavailable right now. Check the Amazon Appstore and your connection, then try again.
purchase_failed: The purchase did not complete. No access has been granted. Check your Amazon purchase history before retrying.
purchase_inactive: No active Premium purchase was verified
verification_pending: Purchase verification could not finish. Restore your purchase when connected.
choose_task_to_complete: Include the exact saved task title, or open Maintenance and choose a task to complete. No changes were made.
